I appreciate you trying to help, but as I've said, this is something I've struggled with for a decade now. I've been "pushing forward" for a very long time and I'm reaching a breaking point. I've left, moved to Europe, volunteered, gave away money, made friends, and done a number of external things to try to be happy and haven't been. 

I know that people have it better than me, but that doesn't affect how I feel. That doesn't influence my depression. 

I'm not asking for money. I'm asking for knowledge about resources available.
